title: Gate 1: layer one's seven checks
summary: nx run e2e:layer1 runs the seven checks of layer one, each with the real architect command in a copy outside the repository: a project from the preset installed from Verdaccio; acme proving; every eval catching its planted break (performance, being review-only, raises a review on a slow grant and prove still passes); an agent writing a handler from its brief alone; the generated CLI, SDK and docs against a running world; add, generate and check building the allowance on the starter; and impact. The agent check runs on the Claude Agent SDK with only four tools of ours, and its whole run is traced into the same OpenTelemetry Collector prove uses.
proves: All seven checks pass locally, 19 tests. In CI, the agent check says it was skipped and why, until CI has an Anthropic key; the rest pass.
